Assertion failure.label: Product behaves differently than expected
Assertion failure.meaning: The site showed or did something other than what the requirement says. Either the product has a defect, or the requirement changed and the test is out of date.
Assertion failure.action: Compare expected and actual. If the site is wrong, raise a defect; if the requirement changed, update the test.

Locator / UI change.label: Screen element missing or changed
Locator / UI change.meaning: The test could not find a button, field or text it expects. Either the screen changed, the feature is not built yet, or part of the page did not load.
Locator / UI change.action: Open the screenshot. If the change is intended, update the test; if not, raise a defect.

Timing / timeout.label: Page too slow or not responding
Timing / timeout.meaning: A page did not load or respond within the time limit. Usually a slow environment or a performance problem.
Timing / timeout.action: Re-run to rule out a one-off. If it repeats, treat it as a performance defect.

Network / environment.label: Environment problem
Network / environment.meaning: The test could not reach the site or a service it depends on, so the check never really ran. This is usually not a product defect.
Network / environment.action: Check the environment is up, then re-run.

Unclassified.label: Needs investigation
Unclassified.meaning: The error did not match a known pattern.
Unclassified.action: Open the trace to find out what happened.
